server.name: terax
server.title: Terax
server.instructions: Controls the running Terax terminal app. Start with terax_inspect (action snapshot) to learn tab ids and what is open, then act with the other tools; every tool takes an `action` plus flat arguments listed in its description. Terminal panes are listed and read through terax_inspect and driven through terax_terminals; private terminals are never exposed. When a call fails to connect, call terax_inspect with action status: Terax must be running for this server to reach it.

tools.name: terax_inspect
tools.title: Inspect Terax
tools.description:
Read the running Terax app without changing it: window layout, tabs, spaces, terminal panes and their scrollback, notes, scheduled tasks, watches, speech, the command catalog, file content search and PNG captures of a surface. Private terminals are never listed or read.

Actions:
- read_graphx(graphId): Read a GraphX document source and revision explicitly.
- status(): Whether a Terax instance is reachable from this server, and which one. Call it first when another call fails to connect.
- snapshot(): Redacted window state: active space and tab, every tab (id, kind, title, cwd), sidebar, scheduled tasks and speech status. Tab ids from here feed the other tools.
- list_commands(): The full registry catalog with every argument, type and enum value.
- build_info(): Repository, branch, commit and channel of the running binary.
- list_terminals(): Every terminal pane that is not private: pane id (leafId), tab, space, directory, focus and the coding agent running in it.
- read_terminal(leafId, lines?): Tail of one terminal pane's scrollback, secrets redacted.
- list_spaces(): Spaces (named groups of tabs) and which one is active.
- list_watches(): Watches with their command, interval, state and last change.
- read_watch(id): One watch with the output of its last run.
- list_notes(): Note cards on the active tab.
- list_tasks(): Scheduled tasks with their prompts and schedules.
- speech_status(): Installed and running speech engines and downloaded models.
- list_voices(language?): Every voice (profiles and presets), with readiness, for speak.
- dictation_status(): Local dictation: provider, engine, model, install jobs, style and memory tiers.
- list_reader_documents(): Documents in the Reader library and where reading stopped.
- reader_state(docId?): A Reader document's position, word, timing, speed and cut points.
- search_content(query, root, caseInsensitive?, maxResults?): Ripgrep content search under a root; secret paths are never returned.
- capture(target, tabId?): Rasterize a Terax surface to a PNG in the app cache and return its path. Refused while a private terminal is in scope.
- wait(ms): Pause before reading state again, for UI changes that settle asynchronously.

action.description: What to do. Each action's arguments are listed in the tool description; ? marks optional ones.

graphId.description: Stable document key returned by graphx.open or app.snapshot.

leafId.description: Id of the terminal pane, from terminal.list.

lines.description: Trailing lines to return, 1 to 2000. Defaults to 200.

id.description: Id of the watch, from watch.list.

docId.description: Reader document id, from reader.list or the snapshot's reader tabs.

query.description: Regular expression in the ripgrep dialect.

root.description: Directory to search under. Must be an authorized workspace path.

maxResults.description: Maximum hits to return, 1 to 500. Defaults to 50.

tabId.description: Tab id, required when target is 'pane'.

tools.name: terax_open_view
tools.title: Open views in Terax
tools.description:
Put something in front of the user in a Terax tab: a file in the editor, a local web preview, a Mermaid diagram, a git diff, the commit graph or a file at a commit. An existing tab for the same target is focused instead of duplicated where the command supports it.

Actions:
- open_file(path, pin?): Open a file in an editor tab.
- open_preview(url, title?): Open a loopback URL (localhost, 127.0.0.1, [::1]) in a preview tab.
- open_graphx(source, graphId?): Create or reopen a stable offline GraphX document from JSON.
- update_graphx(graphId, documentId, expectedRevision, source): Update the same GraphX document using its expected revision.
- place_graphx(graphId, placement): Dock GraphX beside a terminal, float it or return it to its tab.
- open_mermaid(source, title?): Open Mermaid source (48 KiB max) in a new diagram tab.
- update_mermaid(tabId, source, title?): Replace the source of an existing Mermaid tab.
- open_git_diff(repoRoot, path, mode, originalPath?, title?): Open the working-tree (+) or staged (-) diff of one file.
- open_git_history(repoRoot, branch?): Open the commit graph of a repository.
- open_commit_file(repoRoot, sha, path, originalPath?, subject?): Open one file as changed by one commit.

action.description: What to do. Each action's arguments are listed in the tool description; ? marks optional ones.

path.description: open_file: absolute or workspace path. Git actions: path relative to repoRoot.

pin.description: Pin the tab instead of opening it as a preview.

url.description: Loopback URL to load, including scheme (e.g. http://localhost:5173).

title.description: Optional custom tab title (80 characters max for Mermaid tabs).

source.description: Mermaid source for Mermaid actions; JSON text for GraphX actions (48 KiB max).

graphId.description: open_graphx: Stable document key: starts with a letter, up to 64 letters/digits/_/-. Omit to allocate one. update_graphx, place_graphx: Stable GraphX document key.

documentId.description: Document incarnation returned by graphx.read or graphx.open. Prevents writing to a closed and recreated graph.

expectedRevision.description: Current revision returned by graphx.read, graphx.open or the last successful update.

placement.description: Panel location. Dock/float selects an available terminal in the graph's space.

tabId.description: Id of the Mermaid tab returned by mermaid.open or app.snapshot.

mode.description: Diff side: '-' for old, '+' for new.

originalPath.description: Previous path when the file was renamed.

branch.description: Branch name, used only to title the tab.

sha.description: Commit sha, 7 to 40 hexadecimal characters. Revision expressions are not accepted.

subject.description: Commit subject line, shown as context in the tab.

tools.name: terax_manage_tabs
tools.title: Manage Terax tabs
tools.description:
Arrange existing tabs and spaces: focus, rename, colour, reorder, pin or close tabs, move a tab to another space, switch space. Read tab ids with terax_inspect snapshot and space ids with terax_inspect list_spaces first. close_tab removes a tab; everything else is reversible.

Actions:
- focus_tab(tabId): Make a tab active.
- close_tab(tabId?): Close a tab, or the active one when tabId is omitted.
- rename_tab(tabId, title): Set a custom tab title.
- reset_tab_title(tabId): Drop the custom title so the tab follows its content again.
- set_tab_color(tabId, color): Set or clear a tab's accent colour.
- move_tab(tabId, index): Move a tab to an index within its space.
- pin_tab(tabId, pinned): Pin or unpin an editor tab.
- move_tab_to_space(tabId, spaceId): Move a tab to another space.
- focus_space(spaceId): Switch to a space.

action.description: What to do. Each action's arguments are listed in the tool description; ? marks optional ones.

tabId.description: Id of the tab, from terax_inspect snapshot. close_tab closes the active tab when omitted; pin_tab needs an editor tab.

color.description: Palette color, or null to clear the color.

index.description: Zero-based destination index inside the tab's space. Clamped to the strip.

pinned.description: true to pin the tab, false to return it to the preview slot.

spaceId.description: move_tab_to_space: Id of the destination space, from space.list. focus_space: Id of the space, from space.list.

tools.name: terax_terminals
tools.title: Drive Terax terminals
tools.description:
Open, split, focus and close terminal panes, and type into them. Typing runs whatever is at the prompt with the user's permissions, so confirm intent before sending commands that change anything. Read pane ids with terax_inspect list_terminals and their output with terax_inspect read_terminal. Private terminals are refused.

Actions:
- open_terminal(cwd?, command?, title?): Open a terminal tab, optionally running a command in it.
- split_terminal(leafId, direction, command?): Split a pane to the right or down; a tab holds four panes at most.
- focus_terminal(leafId): Focus a pane, switching space and tab as needed.
- close_terminal(leafId): Close a pane and end its shell.
- send_to_terminal(leafId, text, submit?): Type one line into a pane and press Enter (submit false leaves it at the prompt).

action.description: What to do. Each action's arguments are listed in the tool description; ? marks optional ones.

cwd.description: Directory the shell starts in. Defaults to the active terminal's directory.

command.description: Optional one-line command typed and submitted in the new pane once its shell is ready.

leafId.description: Id of the terminal pane, from terax_inspect list_terminals.

direction.description: Where the new pane goes relative to the split one.

text.description: Text to type, one line, 4000 characters at most.

submit.description: Press Enter after the text. Defaults to true; false leaves it at the prompt for the user.

tools.name: terax_watch
tools.title: Watch commands from Terax
tools.description:
Follow something that changes on its own (a pull request, a deploy, a build) without spending agent turns: a watch polls a shell command on an interval and reports when its output changes, by notification or by handing the new output to the Terax AI chat so it can refresh a panel, a GraphX diagram or a note. The command runs unattended with the user's permissions, so confirm it with the user. Read watches with terax_inspect list_watches.

Actions:
- add_watch(name, command, intervalSeconds, cwd?, onChange?, prompt?): Start a watch.
- update_watch(id, name?, command?, intervalSeconds?, cwd?, onChange?, prompt?): Edit a watch.
- remove_watch(id): Stop and delete a watch.
- set_watch_enabled(id, enabled): Pause or resume a watch.
- run_watch(id): Run a watch now.

action.description: What to do. Each action's arguments are listed in the tool description; ? marks optional ones.

name.description: Short label shown in the watch list and in notifications.

command.description: Command whose output is compared between runs, for example gh pr view 42 --json state,reviewDecision,statusCheckRollup. One line, run by the user's login shell. Destructive forms are refused.

cwd.description: Directory the command runs in. Defaults to the active terminal's directory.

onChange.description: What happens when the output changes: notify posts a notification, agent hands the new output and the prompt to the Terax AI chat so it can update panels, graphs or notes, none only records it. Defaults to notify.

prompt.description: With onChange agent: what the agent should do with the new output, for example update the GraphX document pr-radar.

id.description: Id of the watch, from terax_inspect list_watches.

enabled.description: True to resume polling, false to pause it.

tools.name: terax_manage_panels
tools.title: Show and hide Terax panels
tools.description:
Show, hide or toggle the side panels (file sidebar, notes, scheduled tasks, session history, agent monitor), float or dock the notes panel, and open the settings window or the task editor for the user.

Actions:
- show_sidebar(view?): Show the sidebar, optionally on a view.
- hide_sidebar(): Hide the sidebar.
- show_notes(): Show the notes panel.
- hide_notes(): Hide the notes panel.
- toggle_notes(): Toggle the notes panel.
- detach_notes(): Float notes in their own window.
- attach_notes(): Dock floating notes back.
- show_tasks(): Show the scheduled tasks panel.
- hide_tasks(): Hide the scheduled tasks panel.
- toggle_tasks(): Toggle the scheduled tasks panel.
- show_history(): Show the session history graph.
- hide_history(): Hide the session history graph.
- toggle_history(): Toggle the session history graph.
- show_agent_monitor(): Show the agent monitor.
- hide_agent_monitor(): Hide the agent monitor.
- toggle_agent_monitor(): Toggle the agent monitor.
- set_chat_layout(mode, show?): Float the Terax AI chat, dock it left or right, or put it above the bottom bar.
- open_settings(tab?): Open the settings window.
- open_task_editor(id?): Open the task editor so the user can review or finish a task.

action.description: What to do. Each action's arguments are listed in the tool description; ? marks optional ones.

show.description: Show the chat after placing it (default true); false hides it.

id.description: Task to edit. Omit to start a new one.

tools.name: terax_manage_notes
tools.title: Manage Terax notes
tools.description:
Add, edit or remove note cards on the active tab. Read them with terax_inspect list_notes. remove_note deletes a note.

Actions:
- add_note(content): Add a note; a URL becomes a link card, other text a plain note.
- update_note(id, title?, body?, url?, note?): Edit fields of a note.
- remove_note(id): Delete a note.

action.description: What to do. Each action's arguments are listed in the tool description; ? marks optional ones.

id.description: Id of the note card, from terax_inspect list_notes.

body.description: New text for a text note (ignored on link cards).

url.description: New URL for a link card (ignored on text notes).

note.description: New annotation for a link card (empty string clears it).

tools.name: terax_schedule_tasks
tools.title: Schedule Terax agent tasks
tools.description:
Create and drive scheduled tasks: stored prompts Terax hands to a coding agent (pi, claude or codex) on a schedule or on demand. Running a task starts an agent with its own permissions, so confirm intent with the user first. Read tasks with terax_inspect list_tasks.

Actions:
- add_task(name, prompt, schedule, cwd?, target?, mode?, agent?, missed?, overlap?, sessionId?, model?, provider?, thinking?, maxRuns?, tabId?): Create a task.
- update_task(id, name?, prompt?, schedule?, enabled?, cwd?, target?, mode?, agent?, missed?, overlap?, sessionId?, model?, provider?, thinking?, maxRuns?, tabId?): Edit a task.
- clone_task(id): Duplicate a task; the copy starts disabled.
- reseed_task(id): Give a task a fresh agent session so its context starts clean.
- remove_task(id): Delete a task.
- run_task(id): Run a task now.
- set_task_enabled(id, enabled): Enable or disable a task.
- pause_all(): Pause the whole scheduler.
- resume_all(): Resume the scheduler.
- wake(): Re-evaluate the schedule now and dispatch anything due.

action.description: What to do. Each action's arguments are listed in the tool description; ? marks optional ones.

name.description: Short label shown on the task card.

prompt.description: Prompt the agent receives. Multiple lines are allowed.

schedule.description: Schedule spec: manual, every:30m, every:2h, every:1d, daily:09:00, weekly:mon,wed@07:30, weekly:weekdays@08:00, weekly:weekend@10:00, days:3@06:00:2026-08-01, dates:2026-08-04,2026-08-09@12:00, once:2026-08-04T09:15.

cwd.description: Working directory for the run. Defaults to the active tab's directory.

target.description: Where the run happens: a terminal tab (reused or created) or headless.

mode.description: task keeps one session so context accumulates; routine starts a fresh session each run.

agent.description: Agent CLI the run drives. pi and claude can be pinned to a session; codex mints its own ids and can only resume its most recent session in the directory.

missed.description: What to do with occurrences missed while Terax was closed.

overlap.description: What to do when the previous run is still going.

sessionId.description: Existing Pi session to wake. Omit to let Terax own a session for the task.

model.description: Model for the run, passed verbatim to the agent CLI. Omit to inherit its default.

provider.description: Provider for the run. Pi only. Omit to inherit its default.

thinking.description: Thinking level for the run. Pi only. Omit to inherit its default.

maxRuns.description: Stop after this many runs. Omit for unlimited.

tabId.description: Terminal tab this task belongs to, for tab runs.

id.description: Id of the task, from terax_inspect list_tasks.

enabled.description: True to schedule the task, false to stop it.

tools.name: terax_speak
tools.title: Speak through Terax
tools.description:
Read short text aloud on the user's machine with Terax's local speech engines, manage those engines, and run the Reader: a read-along view for long texts, docked as a panel under the tab on screen or in a tab of its own, with word highlighting, bookmarks, scripted pauses, audio export and a library of past readings. Use speech for confirmations and requested summaries, never for logs. Engine installs and model downloads fetch from the network; delete_reader_documents deletes readings and their audio.

Actions:
- speak(text, voiceId?, language?): Speak plain prose; returns once playback starts.
- stop_speaking(): Stop playback and drop the queue.
- start_engine(engine): Start a speech engine.
- stop_engine(engine?): Stop one engine, or all when omitted.
- install_engine(engine, withModel?): Install a speech engine and its default model.
- download_model(model): Download a speech model.
- install_dictation(withModel?): Install the local dictation engine (Rumble-2-Flash, about 1 GB) and its model.
- start_dictation(): Start the local dictation engine.
- stop_dictation(): Stop the local dictation engine.
- transcribe_audio(path, spokenLanguage?, writingStyle?): Transcribe an audio file on this machine with the local dictation engine and the user's dictionary and style.
- open_reader(text?, path?, title?, play?, stdin?, placement?, tabId?, callerPtyId?): Open a text or file in the Reader panel under a tab (or a Reader tab), optionally playing it.
- dock_reader(tabId?, docId?, close?): Show a reading or the library in the Reader panel under a tab, or close it.
- delete_reader_documents(docId?, all?): Delete one reading, or all of them, with their audio.
- control_reader(op, docId?, wordIndex?, positionMs?, speedPercent?): Play, pause, stop, step, seek or change the speed of a Reader document.
- mark_reader(wordIndex, kind, docId?, label?, pauseMs?, remove?): Place or remove a bookmark, scripted pause or stop before a word.
- export_reader(docId?, split?, voiceId?): Start exporting a reading as one WAV, or as one WAV per section, paragraph or sentence; poll reader_state.
- generate_reading(text?, path?, docId?, title?, split?, voiceId?, show?): Generate audio fragments of a text, file or reading in the background (paragraph, heading, sentence or one file); poll reader_state.

action.description: What to do. Each action's arguments are listed in the tool description; ? marks optional ones.

text.description: speak: Text to speak, 1 to 8192 characters after trimming. Plain prose reads best; markup is spoken literally. open_reader, generate_reading: Text to read. Prefer path for long documents.

voiceId.description: speak: Voice profile id from tts.voices. Wins over language when both are given. export_reader, generate_reading: Voice profile id (see tts list_voices); it becomes the document's voice.

language.description: Language whose default voice profile should speak. Omit to use the preferred language.

engine.description: Speech engine. stop_engine stops every running engine when omitted.

withModel.description: install_engine: Also download the engine's default model (Kokoro-82M, Chatterbox Multilingual, Pocket TTS, OmniVoice, ZONOS3-Mini). Default true. install_dictation: Also download Rumble-2-Flash. Default true.

path.description: transcribe_audio: Absolute path of the audio file. open_reader: Absolute path of a text or Markdown file. generate_reading: Absolute path of a text or Markdown file (up to 2 MiB).

spokenLanguage.description: Spoken language, or auto to detect it. Default: the Dictation setting.

writingStyle.description: Writing style: minimal (drop fillers only), prompt, casual or formal. Default: the Dictation setting.

title.description: open_reader: Title shown in the panel header and the library; defaults to the file name or the first words. generate_reading: Title, also the export folder name; defaults to the file name or the first words.

play.description: Start reading right away from the saved position (default false).

stdin.description: The path is a temporary copy of piped input: do not keep it as the source.

placement.description: dock (default): the panel under a tab. tab: a Reader tab of its own.

tabId.description: open_reader: Tab to dock the panel under, from the snapshot; defaults to the tab on screen. dock_reader: Tab whose panel to change, from the snapshot.

callerPtyId.description: Set by terax-read: the terminal that ran it, so the panel opens under that terminal's tab while it is open. Ignored when tabId is given or that terminal is gone.

docId.description: Reader document id, from reader.list or the snapshot's reader tabs.

close.description: Close the panel instead of showing it.

all.description: Delete every document in the library.

op.description: play, pause, toggle, stop, next, previous or seek.

wordIndex.description: control_reader: Word to play or seek to, from reader.state or the document text. mark_reader: The cut sits before this word.

positionMs.description: Document time to seek to, at 1x, scripted pauses included.

speedPercent.description: Reading speed as a percentage: 100 is normal, 150 is 1.5x.

label.description: Label shown in the gutter and used as a chapter title on export.

pauseMs.description: Length of a pause in milliseconds (0 to 60000).

remove.description: Remove the cut of this kind at this word instead of placing it.

split.description: export_reader: none (default): one file. heading, paragraph or sentence: one file per fragment. generate_reading: How to cut the audio: paragraph (default), heading, sentence or none.

show.description: Also show the reading: in the Reader panel under the tab on screen, or in a Reader tab beside it when the tab on screen is a Reader tab. The reply's shown field says where.
